属于 QQ 账号，随聊天慢慢积累。: belongs to the QQ account and is accumulated gradually through chatting.
连接 QQ 后，点同步查看账号收藏。: connects to QQ, click Sync to view account collections.
收藏还是空的。Agent 可以从收到的消息中收藏表情。: collection is still empty. Agents can collect emoticons from received messages.
本次仅同步到部分收藏，数量为当前已同步范围。: is only synchronized to part of the collection this time, and the number is within the current synchronized range.
在 QQ 主人私聊中查看设备状态，也可以直接告诉助手调整卡片。: Check the device status in the QQ owner’s private chat, or directly tell the assistant to adjust the card.
请填写标题，并至少保留一个展示项目。: Please fill in the title and reserve at least one display item.
点击实时预览以连接设备: Click on the live preview to connect the device
属于平台账号，随聊天慢慢积累。: Saved to your platform account as conversations grow.
连接支持收藏表情的平台账号后，点同步查看收藏。: Connect an account that supports saved stickers, then sync to view its collection.
社交服务尚未就绪，请检查后端的社交应用启动日志: The social service is not ready. Check its backend startup logs.
无法连接社交服务，请检查服务是否启动: Cannot connect to the social service. Check whether it is running.
二维码已过期，请重新获取: QR code expired; request a new one
请输入微信显示的验证码: Enter the verification code shown in WeChat
验证码尝试过多，请重新扫码: Too many attempts; scan a new QR code
此账号已绑定，请查看账号列表: Account already linked; check the account list
通过微信 ClawBot 扫码连接，目前支持私聊。: Connect through WeChat ClawBot by scanning a QR code. Direct chats are supported.
使用平台的 Bot Token 添加账号；凭据只保存在后端私有存储。: Add an account using its Bot Token. Credentials stay in private backend storage.
已配置完整群聊消息读取权限，启用主动观察: Full group message access is configured; enable proactive observation
Telegram 需关闭群隐私模式或授予 Bot 管理员权限；同一 Token: Telegram requires disabled group privacy or bot admin rights. Only one update consumer may use a token.
Discord 需在开发者后台开启 Message Content Intent: Enable Message Content Intent in Discord’s developer portal and grant channel access, message history, and send permissions.
以下设置作用于所有社交平台；账号连接与主人身份在各平台内配置。: These settings apply to all social platforms. Configure accounts and owner identity within each platform.
账号凭据仅保存在后端私有存储。: Account credentials are stored only in private backend storage.
获取二维码后扫码: Get a QR code to sign in
使用微信扫一扫，并在手机上确认: Scan with WeChat and confirm on your phone
连接后，在微信私聊中与角色交流: Chat with your character in WeChat direct messages
默认识别扫码账号为主人；需要覆盖时填写 iLink 返回的用户标识。: The scanning account is the owner by default. Enter the user ID returned by iLink to override it.
在 @BotFather 创建机器人，使用 Token 连接。: Create a bot with @BotFather and connect using its token.
向 @BotFather 发送 /newbot 创建机器人: Send /newbot to @BotFather to create a bot
粘贴 Token；添加已有账号会更新其凭据和群聊设置: Paste the token; adding an existing account updates its credentials and group settings
私聊先向机器人发送 /start，群聊则将机器人加入群组: For direct messages, send /start first; for groups, add the bot to the group
已关闭 Group Privacy 或已授予机器人群管理员权限: Group Privacy is disabled or the bot has group admin rights
仅在完成 Telegram 群权限配置后开启；未开启时仍可处理私聊与群内提及。: Enable only after configuring Telegram group permissions. Direct messages and group mentions still work when disabled.
同一 Token 只能由一个服务接收更新，请先停止其他消费者。: Only one service can receive updates for a token. Stop other consumers first.
支持私聊、群组和论坛话题；群消息读取范围由 Telegram 权限决定。: Supports direct messages, groups and forum topics. Telegram permissions determine which group messages are available.
回复保留原话题，无需另建连接: Replies stay in the original topic; no separate connection needed
填写数字 User ID，用于识别主人；不使用 @用户名。: Enter the numeric user ID to identify the owner, rather than an @username.
使用 Developer Portal 中的 Bot Token，通过 Gate: Connect through Gateway using the bot token from the Developer Portal.
已在 Developer Portal → Bot 中开启消息内容权限: Message Content Intent is enabled in Developer Portal → Bot
开启后请求消息内容 Intent 并允许频道主动观察；仍需服务器和频道授权。: Requests Message Content Intent and allows proactive channel observation. Server and channel permissions are still required.
更新权限或凭据时，重新提交该 Bot 的 Token。: Resubmit this bot’s token to update its permissions or credentials.
在 Developer Portal 创建应用并添加 Bot: Create an application and add a bot in the Developer Portal
通过 OAuth2 的 bot scope 将机器人邀请到服务器: Invite the bot to your server using the OAuth2 bot scope
授予查看频道、读取历史、发送消息与附件权限: Grant View Channel, Read Message History, Send Messages and Attach Files
支持私聊、文字频道与线程；线程内发送还需对应线程权限。: Supports direct messages, text channels and threads. Sending in threads requires the corresponding thread permissions.
开启 Discord 开发者模式后复制用户 ID；不使用显示名称。: Enable Discord Developer Mode and copy the user ID, rather than the display name.
通过 NapCat 登录 QQ；进程管理、登录验证与运行日志在此平台内完成。: Sign in to QQ through NapCat. Manage its process, sign-in verification and logs within this platform.
删除当前平台指定私聊的聊天记录。: Delete the specified direct conversation on this platform.
后端尚未提供此平台适配器，请更新后重试。: This platform adapter is not available on the backend. Update it and try again.
